description: Create or update a test suite — the folder cases live in. Without `id` it creates, with `id` it updates. Nest a suite by passing `parent_id`; the whole existing tree comes back from qase_project_context, so read that first rather than guessing at parent IDs. Building a deep tree means one call per node, so create parents before children and reuse the IDs returned. Cost: one API call, about 0.5s.

code.description: Project code (2-10 uppercase letters, numbers, or underscores)

description.description: What this suite groups — shown under the suite title in the tree

id.description: Suite ID — if provided, updates; if omitted, creates

preconditions.description: Setup every case in this suite assumes, inherited by its child suites

name: qase_suite_upsert
title: Create or update suite
